routing_policy.speech: intentional native audio, else exact-format-and-series approved sample via Chatterbox, else MiniMax
routing_policy.retry: one retry on the same route, then stop

fal-ai.name: fal.ai

pricing.avatar: $0.056/sec (Kling Avatar v2; news and gameplay-ai-avatar only)
pricing.video_gen_i2v: $0.08/sec (H3 Max, 768P; ~$0.41 per 5 s clip billed on returned ~5.18 s; fal promo $0.048/sec until 15 Oct 2026)
pricing.video_gen_lipsync: $0.04/sec (H3 Max Turbo lip-sync, 768P; ~$0.21 per 5 s exchange billed on returned length)
pricing.video_gen_face_ref: $0.08/sec (H3 Max reference-to-video, 768P; ~$0.41 per 5 s clip billed on returned ~5.18 s)

fal-ai.notes: video_gen_i2v = MiniMax H3 Max (route minimax.h3max.i2v), the plain I2V route for redcon, item-story, character-story, in-game-pov, wild-documentary, top-list, fake-ad, what-if-real-life I2V scenes and serial-drama action clips. video_gen_lipsync = MiniMax H3 Max Turbo (route minimax.h3max.turbo.i2v + target_audio_url), used only for lip-sync (what-if-real-life and serial-drama dialogue, and every fun-news, special-report and streettalk talking-head scene, which also sends seed 20261021), never for plain clips. video_gen_face_ref = MiniMax H3 Max reference-to-video (route minimax.h3max.r2v: image_url start frame + reference_image_urls headshots), dual-style only. video_gen_i2v_kling_features = Kling v3 Standard (route kling.v3.standard.i2v): not the active route of any of these ten formats; kept as the historical/alternate multi_prompt / voice_ids / elements route and for playbooks that still name a Kling I2V clip. News and gameplay-ai-avatar keep Kling Avatar v2 (avatar); fun-news, special-report and streettalk moved from it to H3 lip-sync after Test 12; motion-dance keeps Kling Motion Control. Each format playbook declares its route; no automatic fallback between them.

minimax.name: MiniMax (via fal.ai)
minimax.notes: voice in voice_setting.voice_id; emotion: angry/happy/sad/neutral; tags: (laughs) (groans) (sighs); pause: <#0.5#>

pricing.still_shot: $0.00 (local ffmpeg; replaces a paid clip on motion: "still" scenes)
